scientific_integrity: Analytical all-dimension proof; exact finite-dimensional checker is corroborative, not a substitute for proof; no independent audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Local linearized spectrum and local hyperbolic stability only; unit-circle nonlinear behavior, random-order sweeps, other coupling weights and global basins are not determined. Closely related 1999/2000 primary studies were not available in full.
title: Exact cyclic-sweep spectrum and sharp finite-population stabilization under complete mean coupling
